gaps.what: `carry` — who moves a Petition onto a DocketItem, and what it costs them
gaps.needs: a specified carry act with a named payer; `02` §7.1 names the chain, `08` has no signature

gaps.what: covert action: an Event has no field separating the deed from its doer, so witnessing an act necessarily reveals its actor
gaps.needs: attribution as a separate, per-witness claim from the occurrence

gaps.what: Conviction motion: `02` §5.5 says convictions move 'slowly, by scar and crisis'
gaps.needs: a scar object, an owner, a write class, and a crisis rule

gaps.what: the ledger cap `L` and the eviction comparator (`confidence_live x recency`)
gaps.needs: a value for L and a specified eviction order; `11_PARAMS` grades it assumption

gaps.what: construal divergence: `witness` is per-person but nothing in it VARIES by person, so two witnesses of one event necessarily agree
gaps.needs: a per-person construal term (stance/capability/channel) inside witness()

gaps.what: feud inheritance: nothing at death writes the deceased's stances into a kinsman's interior, and claim confidence decays — so an enmity is LOST BY BEING FORGOTTEN
gaps.needs: a WITNESS/CENSUS rule depositing high-weight stances into kin ledgers

gaps.what: custody: `03` §1.3 homes a Record as Rung matter, so a clerk's CUSTODY of it is not represented — `01` §3.1 names custody as one of four things that make an ordinary person matter, and no field carries it
gaps.needs: custody as a Tenure (a `hold` over a Record), or a named custodian field

gaps.what: conflicting obligation: two `oblige` Tenures may coexist and nothing computes that satisfying one breaches the other; the collision rule is specified for Propositions (`02` §3, intersecting `when`), not for obligations
gaps.needs: an obligation-collision Query, or oblige carrying a Proposition it discharges

gaps.what: `leaders()` comparator — `02` §10 item 2 proposes 'commitment degree x backing raisable', unadopted
gaps.needs: a comparator; and it must read `succeed` edges before it (see FINDINGS §2.8)

gaps.what: the ghost polity: every member has decommitted, the Proposition is immutable and never destroyed, and its `hold` Tenure over a settlement has NO PRODUCER TO END IT — revocation names a venue, and no person remains who can appear at one
gaps.needs: a hold whose subject-Proposition has no live commits becomes contestable as vacant custody at the venue that would have heard its revocation

gaps.what: the judging set's decision rule at a sitting — `02` §2.2 names `judging_set_rule` as a Rung field and no document specifies its form or how a motion is carried
gaps.needs: a specified decision rule; the archive has ten motion types and two vote models

gaps.what: band strobing: 7 crossing events in 6 seasons at the tending equilibrium. A band edge is a single threshold, so recovery costs exactly what decline gave back and the site oscillates across it, spamming witnessed crossings and flickering verbs
gaps.needs: paired (fall_edge, rise_edge) per band — the archive's ratified +8 gap

gaps.what: an agentive actorless row — 'an empire demands a levy' is an actor's decision rendered as weather. `05` §4.4 blocks it until a criterion exists that stops any actor being reclassified as weather
gaps.needs: the agentive/non-agentive criterion, or a simulated foreign person

gaps.what: the judging set's decision rule at a sitting — `02` §2.2 names `judging_set_rule` as a Rung field and no document specifies its form or how a motion is carried
gaps.needs: a specified decision rule; the archive has ten motion types and two vote models

gaps.what: an Event writing social row (Office, post)
gaps.needs: an Act by a person

gaps.what: provenance: `resolve` emits Events with an EMPTY causes[] — nothing in the specified loop populates the causal edge that `06` §1 calls the arc itself
gaps.needs: resolve() to attribute each Event to the claims/events that motivated its act

gaps.what: boundedness: grievance rose monotonically to 9 over 8 seasons with nothing damping it. Per-tick emission caps bound a cascade WITHIN a season; nothing bounds a behavioural spiral ACROSS seasons, and no guard or measurement is licensed for it
gaps.needs: a termination argument per self-feeding mechanism + a sustained-shock battery

gaps.what: (Person, capability) has no row in the Partition schema
gaps.needs: a social: bool column entry

gaps.what: marriage: `01` Law 4 names marriage as a governed social change, but no Tenure kind carries it — `tie` is an affective bond that DECAYS, and a dynastic marriage is a durable political instrument that binds two houses and routes succession
gaps.needs: marriage as an `oblige`-class Tenure with a payload, or an eighth kind

gaps.what: subsistence: `02` §8.1 says subsistence happens TO a person at MATTER, but no step consumes stores on their behalf and no rule links a person to a larder — so `need` in `Sensation` has no producer either
gaps.needs: a MATTER draw per contained person against the Rung's stores

gaps.what: individuation: `05` row 13 requires the world to mint a Person on demand with no decider, and no rule says WHAT TRIGGERS IT or what interior the new person starts with — `02` §10 item 3 carries the 'plausible past' as open and ruled-against in three placements
gaps.needs: a trigger condition and a specified starting interior for a minted person

gaps.what: the lapse: `05` §5.1 calls a date passing unheard 'a real consequence' with 'nobody's act, nobody to blame' — but nothing EMITS it, so the specific injury of being ignored is not witnessable and cannot enter anyone's ledger
gaps.needs: CALENDAR to emit a lapse Event for a date that fired with no answering act

gaps.what: no step decrements a Record's ttl. `05` rows 11a/11b make a ttl expiry and an act-created term's ripening the carriers for cooldowns, remissions and truces — and MATTER never touches them
gaps.needs: a MATTER pass over Records decrementing ttl and emitting expiry

gaps.what: vacancy-by-absence: `06` row 3 requires a convening condition to read PRESENCE, so that making a man absent substitutes for killing him — `ConveningCondition` is a six-field object the adversarial pass found had no owner, and its predicate form is unspecified
gaps.needs: a specified ConveningCondition predicate that can read a person's address

gaps.what: an Event writing social row (Tenure, hold)
gaps.needs: an Act by a person

gaps.what: staged institutional judgement: a stage computed as a Query over current stances REVERTS the moment the stances do, so an army that has decided its king is unfit un-decides it after one good season. A ratchet needs state that survives its inputs, and Law 3 forbids exactly that state
gaps.needs: either a per-person scar/ratchet the Query reads (see P4), or an explicit exception to Law 3 for monotone institutional judgement

gaps.what: deferral: a person who chooses nothing produces no Act, so no Event, so nothing enters anyone's ledger — a ruler's sustained refusal to decide is INVISIBLE to the world and indistinguishable from his absence
gaps.needs: an abstention that emits, so that not-deciding is witnessable and chargeable

gaps.what: publicness: the same act by a king and by a copyist produces Events identical in scope and witnessability. Nothing in Act, Event or witness() reads the actor's office, so office cannot make an act cost more — and `07` §5 asks precisely that it do so
gaps.needs: a witnessability term keyed on the actor's standing/office, not on the act

gaps.what: privacy: WITNESS as specified fans every Event out to every person, so there is no private utterance — a councillor's frank advice is heard by the whole realm. `06` §4.2 names five witness CHANNELS as the cast gate, but the loop never consults them
gaps.needs: witness() to consult presence/channel before depositing, not after

gaps.what: act cooldown: the claim was pressed 3 seasons running with no cost and no bar. `05` §4.1 gives event ROWS a required cooldown; nothing gives an ACT one, so a failed bid for a throne is a free repeatable check rather than a bet
gaps.needs: a per-act-kind cooldown carried by the actor, or a Record with a ttl that gates eligibility (the shape already has the Record; nothing writes it here)

gaps.what: accumulation vs decay: Edeyja holds 6 claims of harm, but the only accumulator the shape offers is a ledger whose confidence DECAYS and whose rows are EVICTED at a cap. A threshold over 'visible harm accumulated' is therefore a race between witnessing and forgetting, and the shape has no counter that only goes up
gaps.needs: a monotone per-person tally (the archive's scar is exactly this shape), or an explicit statement that patience is a Query over undecayed claims and is losable

gaps.what: contested formation: investments in a person resolve as Events he witnesses, but nothing converts accumulated tutoring into a DURABLE alignment, and nothing closes a window after which it LOCKS. `02` §10 item 3 carries the 'plausible past' of a newly made person as open; this is the same hole seen from the other end — how a person's interior is FORMED
gaps.needs: a specified route from repeated acts upon a person to that person's convictions (which is P4's missing mechanism again), plus a lock condition

gaps.what: craft: `02` §7.4 has `Record` — the only non-person root-bearer, keepable at a Rung, burnable, admissible at a venue — which is exactly the object a copyist makes. But no act CREATES one: `resolve` emits Events and nothing mints a Record, so the shape has the noun and not the verb
gaps.needs: a `create`-mode StateChange whose subject is a Record, produced by an act

gaps.what: possession: a Record is homed as Rung matter, so it is at a PLACE and never in a person's hands — 'she was found with it' is not expressible, and possession-as-offence has no subject. P10 found the same hole from the custody side; they are one gap
gaps.needs: a person-to-Record `hold` Tenure, which also closes P10

gaps.what: work-in-progress: `02` §8.1 names travel-in-progress as ticking at MATTER, but there is no general partial-work record, so every act completes or fails within its season. A craft, a school, a survey or a long investigation cannot be half-done and interrupted
gaps.needs: an act that deposits a Record with remaining effort, which MATTER advances

gaps.what: environmental cost: a person contained at a Rung whose Site is derelict takes NOTHING from it. MATTER wears Sites; nothing wears the PEOPLE standing next to them, so a Warden's thirty-one years of proximity to substrate damage is free
gaps.needs: a MATTER pass from Site condition onto contained persons — the same shape as subsistence (P16), which is also missing

gaps.what: sacrifice: `resolve` reads no stake from an Act, so spending your life on an act cannot buy a different outcome than performing it and living. Orm's death-seal and an ordinary seal are the same Event
gaps.needs: a declared stake on an Act that the resolver may read, priced against the ladder

gaps.what: two standings: `Sensation.standing` is a single scalar defined as what EVERYONE reads off you, so a reputation held only among people who can never publicly credit you has no carrier — and a covert operative's whole economy is that second, unreadable standing
gaps.needs: standing as a Query over a NAMED audience, not a global scalar
